authenticated_failure.failure_class: A short-lived labeled container disappeared before first live membership proof. Its exit cause is unknown; guard correctly refused unverified disappearance. Poll frequency cannot make this admission race impossible.

design: Reuse Docker create/start/inspect and existing guard; no new daemon, queue, service or credential mechanism.
Create retained container with unchanged pinned image, worker identity, 6GiB memory/swap caps and worker slice. No --rm in bounded native mode.

Host creates a unique private gate under guard-owned /tmp root outside writable /work and home mounts. Immutable guard snapshot of the shell entrypoint and per-container gate directory are mounted read-only.

Before start, atomically publish request binding full Docker ID, token, worker, pinned image, original absolute deadline and exact command. docker start --attach supplies normal output and command exit status.

Entrypoint can only wait for ACK until the same absolute deadline; it cannot execute requested native command before ACK. Guard verifies full inspect identity/caps, exact Config/readonly Mounts, request and live PID/start/cgroup membership, then atomically publishes token:fullCID ACK.
After ACK, gate execs timeout with remaining original budget and original argv (no eval). Guard continues actual running membership checks on each observation.

Retained exited containers preserve State.ExitCode/OOMKilled/Error. Before success, union durable requests, admitted IDs and daemon labels; require exact nonempty inventory equality and every retained container admitted and exited0. A missing container always fails, including previously verified IDs.
Existing serialized, time-bounded cleanup stops producer before removing owned containers and stopping anchor/watchdog; final owned container/unit absence remains mandatory.

class_coverage.before_first_observation: Legitimate helpers cannot finish native work before membership observation: startup blocks for ACK. An externally failed/killed gate remains retained and is rejected as unadmitted or nonzero. Missing gate/identity is never accepted.
class_coverage.after_verified_observation: Short native commands may finish between polls; immutable retained ID and terminal status remain inspectable until guard cleanup, eliminating --rm disappearance. Generic inspection errors remain fatal.
class_coverage.failed_exits: Native exec preserves nonzero status; guard captures terminal state before rejecting. A swallowed helper error still fails final per-container validation.
class_coverage.cleanup: All created containers remain worker labeled for existing targeted cleanup even if create/start/request publication fails. Empty/unpublished gate requests or unmatched labels block final success. Cleanup success is not native success.
